title: History of Ancient Bengal
note: R. C. Majumdar, History of Ancient Bengal, first edition, Calcutta: G. Bharadwaj & Co., June 1971. The title page and Rajshahi University Library catalog agree on title, author, place, publisher, year, and first edition. This regional history synthesizes classical literary accounts and later evidence; its Gangaridai discussion reflects the historian's interpretations and explicitly notes contradictions among ancient descriptions.
whyItMatters: Majumdar collates ancient Greek and Roman reports about Gangaridai and discusses their conflicting geography and relationship with the Prasioi, making the limits of later historical reconstruction visible.
